title: The Principal Scheme
strategies: eager/flat solve: unify the definition constraints and every use-site constraint together as one monomorphic system, in file order -- whatever ground type the first use pins a slot to sticks for every later use
solve-then-commit-to-first-use: solve the definition alone, then for each variable it leaves free, fix it to whatever ground type the first use site (in file order) happens to want
blind default: solve the definition alone, fix every variable it leaves free to a constant default type without consulting any use site

solve-then-generalize: solve the definition constraints alone, and report every variable they leave unresolved as a universally-quantified label instead of a ground type, deferring instantiation to each use's own generalization point
